items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: I remember one time we played with Muddy Waters in Los Angeles, man.

ctx.x: John Lee Hooker. I mean, you know, the stuff that he plays. And the other man, Muddy Waters, I mean, the stuff that you were playing, I mean, you couldn't dance to their music. I mean, it was like a concert for them, you know. You sit down and look and listen with them. But when we went up there, a lot of people thought that was uncomfortable. When Lloyd went there, we had guys who could play and read. And like I said, Joe Anderson had arrangements, man. And we took those arrangements and put them up there, man.…
